page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with a narrow column of margin notes on the right. Running head and page number at the top. A catchword and gathering signature at the foot. Show-through from the facing page in the left margin is not transcribed.

main_text.head: II. ROMANORUM.
main_text.p: Imperium Romanorum(2)Romanorum, cujus notetur 1. fundatio. fundavit Augusti*.
main_text.head: Explicatio 1.
main_text.p: Per quas mutationes & vicissitudines atque gradus respubl. Romana circumacta fuerit, donec veluti fessa & victoribus exhausta in finum Augusti se conjiceret, sefforemque[?] Augustum, veluti equus recalcitrando defatigatus, facile patere-tur, Tacit.l.1. Annal.c.1. compendio refert.
main_text.head: Explicatio 2.
main_text.p: Sub Augusto igitur Imperium Romanorum demum obtinuit summum suum fastigium atq; perfectionem, sub quo etiam florentissimum fuit, ac pax per universum terrarum orbem; unde ipse Salvator Mundi Chri-

page.notes: Right margin: the note is set in short lines with hyphenation, "(2)Ro-/mano-/rum. cujus notetur 1. funda-/tio.", and is given here as one note beside the canon. Reading "sefforemque" in the line "sefforemque Augustum" is doubtful and is marked [?]. The asterisk after "Augustus" is a printed dingbat or reference mark and is copied as "*". Italic and roman in "Tacit.l.1. Annal.c.1." is partly unclear. The paragraph "Sub Augusto" continues onto the next page. Show-through from the facing page appears in the left margin and is excluded.
